title: Did everyone pass?
hints: Trace `everyonePassed([80, 40, 90], 50)` by hand. How many scores does the loop actually look at before the function ends?
`return` ends the whole function, not just this round of the loop. The `else` branch gives up after checking only the first score.
You can only say "everyone passed" after the loop has checked every score. Remove the `else` branch and let the `return true` after the loop do that job.
